fact: The Minister of Finance and National Planning's foreword, dated July 2023, presents the Second National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS2) for 2023-2027 as the national strategy for Zambia's statistical system.
The document states the first NSDS (NSDS1) ended in 2018.
The document states NSDS1 was evaluated in 2017 by an inter-agency team of the African Development Bank, UN Economic Commission for Africa, COMESA and PARIS21, which recommended a second NSDS.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): NSDS 2023-2027.
